action_plan.title: Eliminate SQLi, XSS, CSRF, and broken access control across REST, AJAX, and Admin handlers
action_plan.action: Enforce ABSPATH guards, current_user_can('manage_options'), wp_verify_nonce/check_ajax_referer/check_admin_referer, $wpdb->prepare() + esc_like(), esc_html()/esc_attr(), and remove wp_ajax_nopriv / __return_true / print_r.
action_plan.expected_impact: Neutralizes all 5 HIGH CWE-89/CWE-79 sinks and unauthenticated PII exposure / destructive log purge.

action_plan.title: Remediate all CWE-89 SQLi, CWE-79 XSS, hardcoded secret, and unauthenticated REST/AJAX endpoints
action_plan.action: Remove $map_webhook_secret literal, replace all 3 raw $wpdb queries with $wpdb->prepare(), escape all rendered $_GET/$_POST values, and enforce manage_options + nonce verification across REST, AJAX, and admin endpoints.
action_plan.expected_impact: Eliminates critical remote SQL injection, PII exfiltration, arbitrary log deletion, and XSS risks.

action_plan.title: Remove hardcoded $map_webhook_secret and externalize via wp-config/env secret

action_plan.title: Replace @file_get_contents with timeout-bounded wp_remote_get and remove print_r
action_plan.action: Use wp_remote_get() with explicit timeout and WP_Error handling in settings-page.php:21 and delete the ?debug print_r() branch in rest-endpoints.php:20-22.
action_plan.expected_impact: Eliminates hung PHP worker threads and debug data leaks.

summary: wp_plugin_messy (Member Analytics Portal v1.3.0) scores 60/100 (Grade C overall, Security 30/100 Grade D, Documentation 27/100 Grade D, Typing 36/100 Grade D) due to systemic WordPress security failures across every module. While isolated PHP 8.2 runtime syntax checks (php -l) and WordPress hook loading (5 hooks) succeeded with 0 declared Composer CVEs, SAST and AST inspection uncovered 1 hardcoded webhook secret ($map_webhook_secret), 5 HIGH CWE dangerous sinks (3x CWE-89 unparameterized $wpdb SQL injection querying wp_users and deleting wp_map_events, 2x CWE-79 unescaped XSS plus shortcode $_GET XSS), unauthenticated PII exposure via REST permission_callback=>'__return_true' and wp_ajax_nopriv, subscriber-level ('read') admin settings privilege escalation without nonces, missing ABSPATH guards in all 4 files, 0% typing/PHPDoc, and 0 automated tests.
